harness: AgentDojo, logs record agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 and benchmark_version v1.2.1 in all 990 (phase-10c census); requirements.txt pins agentdojo[transformers]==0.1.29 since the initial commit, so the requirements do not describe the installed code. The e2e run manifests (data/results/e2e_eval/*/manifest.json) record agentdojo_version 0.1.35, llamafirewall_version 1.0.3, the repo git_commit at run time (0d8c12b9, 3071d6af, d7a689f4 dirty; 99d7acd4 clean for run 3) and agent_pipeline_name gpt-4o-2024-05-13; the smoke run 20260414_061406 records agentdojo_version 'unknown'. AgentDojo 0.1.35 = PyPI/GitHub release 2025-10-27 (latest release). Pipeline: AgentPipeline.from_config(llm=gpt-4o-2024-05-13, defense=None, default system message), OpenAI retry patch (20 attempts); attack ImportantInstructionsAttack with attack.name overridden to e2e_<condition>_<injection_task> and the candidate priming string spliced into the injected environment by a monkey patch of load_and_inject_default_environment (src/e2e_evaluate.py). Base logs: src/generate_traces.py, load_attack('important_instructions'), benchmark v1.2.1, slack. Relevant open AgentDojo issues: #168 (slack injection_task_5 security_from_traces counts attempted membership calls as executed), #189 (closed; same for proposed calls), #218 (utility_from_traces counts proposed calls), #188 (slack utility KeyError when post_webpage does not execute; only with blocking defences), #214 (non-ASCII tool results as \uXXXX escapes), #194 (slack invite interface). No defence in these runs, so #168/#188/#189 can matter only where a tool call failed with an error.
